scene_analysis.scene_overview: A narrow street in a city with tall buildings on both sides,
scene_analysis.buildings: The left side has a cream-colored facade with balconies and windows, while the right side has a tan-colored facade with a blue awning over the entrance to a business.
scene_analysis.materials: The left side has a mix of stone and concrete, while the right side has a smooth concrete facade.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several motorcycles parked along the sidewalk, as well as a few chairs and tables outside the businesses.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are small trees planted in the median between the two streets.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted on the buildings, including a large sign reading 'Museo de la Vila' above the entrance to the left.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area appears to be residential, with apartments and shops lining the street.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is popular with students, with many young people walking around.
